title: Benefit Exhibit: Annual Medical Deductible and Maximum Out-of-Pocket by Group Retiree Plan
content:
The in-network medical deductible for the plan year, the annual in-network maximum out-of-pocket and the annual combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket are scheduled below for each plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans, in USD.

| Group plan | In-network medical deductible | In-network maximum out-of-pocket | Combined in- and out-of-network maximum out-of-pocket |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | 250.00 | 4800.00 | 9600.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | 0 | 3900.00 | 7800.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | 0 | 2700.00 | 5400.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading of the exhibit

All three figures are annual figures for the plan year.

A medical deductible is scheduled on one plan of the book alone, Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO), at 250.00. Every other plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans is scheduled at 0.

Maximum out-of-pocket figures are scheduled on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO). They are scheduled at 0 on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP).

Where an in-network maximum is scheduled, the combined figure scheduled beside it is twice it: 9600.00 beside 4800.00, 7800.00 beside 3900.00 and 5400.00 beside 2700.00. Among the three plans that carry one, the in-network figure falls as the plan rises; a deductible above zero is scheduled on one plan of the book only.
